results.remarks: California character meets easy, modern living in this inviting single-story home, held by the same owners for over 30 years. Built in 1961 in the highly desirable Executive Tract of Paramount, it offers three bedrooms and two remodeled bathrooms in approximately 1,668 square feet on a generous 7,376-square-foot lot. At the heart of the home, the remodeled kitchen features expansive quartz countertops, a farmhouse-style sink, recessed lighting, and a long peninsula opening to the adjoining living area. A brick fireplace and wood-plank-and-beam ceiling add architectural character, while crisp white walls and abundant natural light keep everything bright and fresh. Spacious living areas connect naturally while still offering distinct places to gather, and pocket doors close off the bedroom wing from the kitchen and living spaces for added privacy. Additional conveniences include an interior laundry room, central heat and air, and pull-down ladder access to the attic. Outside, mature trees, established landscaping, beautiful brickwork, and a custom pool and spa create a private resort designed for Southern California living. The backyard also features a built-in bar with firepit and custom palapa, a custom pond with cascading waterfall, a corner moai head fountain, and an expansive covered patio with ceiling fans. The attached three-car garage provides ample parking, storage, and flexible space, and the finished garage extends the home's indoor-outdoor possibilities with sliding doors opening directly to the backyard. One garage is already configured to work beautifully as an office, studio, gym, or poolside entertaining area. Major improvements are done: in 2015 the roof was taken down to new plywood sheathing and re-roofed with a 30-year dimensional shingle, and in 2020 a 13.3 kW rooftop solar array was installed along with an upgrade to a 200-amp main electrical panel. Termite clearance has also been completed, with the report available in the supplement section. Anything but cookie-cutter, this is a home with genuine personality, from its distinctive architectural details and remodeled interiors to the rare three-car garage and unforgettable resort-style backyard. Buyer and buyer's agent to verify all square footage, permits, permitted uses, and the status of the solar system with the City of Paramount.

results.remarks: Experience the best of Marina District living in this stylish south-facing residence at Renaissance, where panoramic water and city views pair beautifully with an exceptionally spacious floor plan. Don’t miss your chance to call this special residence your own!

results.remarks: Tucked into the gated enclave of Del Cerro Heights, this fully reimagined residence pairs designer finishes with sweeping ocean and sunset vistas that stretch clear across the city. Perched in one of the neighborhood's most coveted pockets, and zoned for the highly-regarded Hearst Elementary, Lewis Middle, and Patrick Henry High, the location is as compelling as the home itself. Enter the home and the scale speaks first: 15-foot vaulted ceilings, walls of glass, and an open floor plan that pulls daylight into every corner. Automated blinds in the living room make it effortless to dial in light and privacy on demand. The remodel left nothing behind: a sleek contemporary kitchen, fully refreshed bathrooms, and a primary suite that has been completely reimagined with an oversized walk-in closet and a spa-inspired en-suite built for slow mornings. Wide-plank luxury vinyl runs continuously throughout, lending warmth and a clean, cohesive flow from room to room. Sustainability is built in with an owned solar system that powers efficient day-to-day living, and the oversized garage adds loft storage for everything that doesn't quite fit anywhere else. Beyond the front door, the gated community delivers resort-level amenities: a large pool and spa, tennis courts, a fitness center, sauna, and a private park. Come live in one of San Diego's most scenic hilltop communities.

results.remarks: Residence 1704 at Aria presents a rare opportunity to experience elevated San Diego living from a 17th-floor northwest corner residence. Offering 1,355 sq. ft., 2 bedrooms and 2 baths, this exceptional home is wrapped in expansive corner windows that capture extraordinary natural light and panoramic views in three directions. The ever-changing panorama extends from the lush greenery of Balboa Park across San Diego Bay to the Downtown skyline and Coronado Bridge, with dramatic sunsets over Point Loma. The coveted northwest orientation provides abundant natural light throughout the day while helping minimize the heat and glare of the stronger midday and early-afternoon sun.  The views are not limited to the living spaces—they are enjoyed from the kitchen, both bedrooms and even the bathrooms. The living and dining areas open seamlessly to a covered terrace, creating a private outdoor extension of the home. It is an ideal setting for morning coffee, sunset cocktails or effortless entertaining against a backdrop of bay sunsets, illuminated city lights and aircraft quietly approaching San Diego International Airport.  Inside, the residence has been thoughtfully refreshed for a sophisticated, move-in-ready experience. Brand-new premium flooring offers the refined appearance of light wood with commercial-grade durability, while both bedrooms feature brand-new carpeting. Fresh interior paint throughout creates a crisp, pristine backdrop.  (see supplemental comments!)  The contemporary kitchen pairs sleek European-style cabinetry with dark stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances and an expansive peninsula that opens naturally to the living and dining areas—perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The desirable split-bedroom floor plan provides excellent privacy, and the primary bath features dual vanities and a walk-in shower. An in-unit washer and dryer add convenience.  The location within Aria is equally impressive. Positioned at the southern end of SR-163, the building provides immediate access to San Diego's regional freeway network, while Residence 1704 faces away from the freeway and remains remarkably quiet. Two assigned parking spaces on the first garage level offer quick entry and exit with unusually easy maneuvering. The residence is just steps from the elevator, making arrivals with groceries or luggage effortless while remaining comfortably removed from elevator noise. With only four residences sharing the 17th floor, the home enjoys an additional level of privacy. A private, secure storage space is also included.  Aria delivers the advantages of full-service high-rise living with an uncommon sense of community. Attentive management, professional staff, controlled access and concierge service complement a collection of amenities designed for both relaxation and connection, including a heated pool and spa, fitness center, resident lounge, conference room, event space and dedicated bicycle storage. Impeccably maintained common areas complete the experience.  Set in Cortez Hill, Residence 1704 places the best of San Diego within easy reach while maintaining a peaceful residential atmosphere. Balboa Park is close by for morning walks and runs, gardens, museums, theater and cultural events. Little Italy, the Gaslamp Quarter, the waterfront and San Diego's beaches are all nearby, and San Diego International Airport is just minutes away. The result is a uniquely balanced lifestyle: the city's culture, dining, entertainment, nature and connectivity are remarkably close, yet the energy and congestion of the city remain outside your door. Residence 1704 combines sweeping views, sophisticated updates, exceptional convenience and the quiet refinement of one of Aria's most desirable corner locations.

From the moment you enter the unit, the view commands your attention, framed by a stunning open-concept kitchen featuring wood shaker cabinetry with brushed bronze hardware, a stone backsplash, marbled quartz countertops, a spacious four-person bar-top, and all-new appliances. The adjoining dining and living areas maximize the panoramic views and open to a private balcony, complete with a built-in recessed wet bar—perfect for entertaining. The luxurious primary suite offers three closets, custom built-in cabinetry, and a spa-inspired ensuite that steals the show. Stone floors and walls seamlessly transition into rich forest green tile surrounding the freestanding soaking tub, dual vanity, and stand-up shower. The shower is finished with custom backlighting, dual recessed niches, and both rain and handheld shower fixtures. The secondary bathroom mirrors the same designer finishes, creating a cohesive and sophisticated aesthetic throughout the home. Additional upgrades include fresh interior paint, oak-colored luxury vinyl plank flooring, modern lighting, new baseboards, and more. Residents of Brittany Tower enjoy full-service amenities including front desk security, a resort-style pool and spa, fitness center, and an unbeatable location with quick access to downtown, the waterfront, and major freeways.

results.remarks: In the upscale Groves complex, a rarely available one-story end unit is finally for sale! The home also includes a two-car garage and a private garden / patio area, offering additional outdoor space for pets, or relaxing. results.remarks: SPANNING VIEWS FROM EVERY ROOM OF THE OCEAN, SAN DIEGO BAY, PT. LOMA AND DOWNTOWN WATERFRONT AREA. This 2 bedroom 2 1/2 bath corner unit rarely comes on the market for sale at Renaissance. Come see this customized home that has remodeled bathrooms, custom paint, including a unique column mural in the dining area. Owner was on the Board of the SD Zoo and used as a 2nd home to attend meetings, so residence, décor and furniture are safari themed. This open corner floor plan has lots of windows for the bay & ocean sunsets, including sectional window walls that open up with balcony railings to bring the outdoors into the residence. Kitchen includes Sub-Zero refrigerator, Viking hood, stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, kitchen island and European style cabinets. Custom wood floors in living & dining area and carpet in the bedrooms. Master bedroom is spacious and includes a large walk-in closet and master bath has dual vanity, marble flooring, counters and shower walls. Separated 2nd bedroom with ensuite remodeled bathroom and walk-in closet. Powder bath and washer & dryer located at entry hallway.  Marina District is one of the best and safest residential neighborhoods in downtown SD. Ralphs Grocery Store is across the street and a short walk to many of San Diego's favorite restaurants, Convention Center and the waterfront area. Amenities are endless, with pool, spa, fitness facility, nearby dog park, completely remodeled lobby and community room & kitchen, and a NEW street front entry on Front Street. Residence includes 2 side-by-side parking spaces near elevator!

results.remarks: Rarely available three-bedroom penthouse in Carmel Pointe, ideally positioned in a quiet, private location within the community with peaceful treetop views from nearly every room.  The home has been thoughtfully updated with freshly painted interiors, recessed lighting throughout, white kitchen cabinetry, new carpet in the living room and hallways, and a remodeled primary bathroom. The functional floor plan offers an inviting living space centered around a fireplace, with large windows that bring in natural light and greenery from outside.  The spacious primary suite offers a comfortable retreat and abundant natural light. The primary bathroom has been updated with a clean, modern feel that complements the home’s overall style and warmth. Positioned on the opposite end of the home are two sizable guest bedrooms, offering flexibility for family, guests, or a home office setup while providing added privacy from the primary suite.  Carmel Pointe residents enjoy access to a resort-style pool and spa, clubhouse, fitness center, designated EV charging stations, and beautifully maintained grounds, all within the award-winning Torrey Pines school district. Conveniently located near One Paseo and Del Mar Highlands, with easy access to shopping, dining, and everyday essentials, Del Mar's beaches are just 2.5 miles away.  Additional highlights include a detached one-car garage plus three additional parking spaces — a rare offering for the area.

results.remarks: Welcome to one of the most unique and distinguished residences in East Village's ICON. This 6th floor, townhome style corner unit features dramatic two-story window walls and breathtaking south and west-facing views of the city skyline and Petco Park. Fully renovated from top to bottom, this sophisticated home offers an open-concept kitchen and living area, engineered hardwood flooring throughout, and electric remote-controlled blackout shades on every window. The flexible floor plan includes a bedroom and full bath on the entry level, along with a spacious storage area, while the upper level offers two additional bedrooms and two bathrooms. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with a private balcony off the living room and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. Two premium parking spaces on P1 are located near the garage entrance. Offered with the option to be sold fully furnished, this exceptional residence combines style and convenience. ICON residents enjoy 24/7 concierge and security, access to the fitness center, community lounge, and the exclusive 25th floor rooftop Skybox Terrace with panoramic views directly into Petco Park, Downtown skyline, and the bay. The Ballpark District East Village consists of 130 blocks of coffee shops, brewries, art galleries, entertainment venues including Petco Park.  ICON is in the "clean zone" surrounding the ballpark and includes heightened security, cleaning, and landscaping.  Ideally located within walking distance to Padres games, the Gaslamp Quarter, shops, restaurants, and the waterfront, this home offers the very best of urban living.

results.remarks: Residence 1706 offers an expansive open-concept design where city views become part of the living experience. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors fill the residence with natural light and open to a private terrace, while exposed brick, a designer kitchen and a spacious primary suite add character and comfort throughout. An exceptional opportunity to experience the Meridian lifestyle in the heart of the Marina District.  Welcome to The Meridian, San Diego’s premier luxury high-rise in the heart of the Marina District. Residence 1706 is a stylish onebedroom, one-and-a-half-bath retreat showcasing sweeping city views from the moment you enter. The open floor plan is anchored by a designer kitchen with a center island, bar-style seating, and a chic brick accent wall that adds warmth and character to the living and dining areas. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors extend the living space onto a spacious patio—perfect for entertaining or simply taking in the skyline. The primary suite offers custom cabinetry and a newly renovated ensuite bath, thoughtfully designed with a spa inspired oversized soaking tub and a separate shower—all while framing captivating city views. Nearly every room enjoys a stunning outlook, creating a light-filled urban sanctuary. Life at The Meridian is truly resort-like, with five-star amenities including 24-hour valet parking, attentive concierge service, a private pool and spa, and a beautifully landscaped BBQ plaza with both bay and city vistas. Experience elevated downtown living in one of San Diego’s most prestigious addresses.

results.remarks:
Historic Mills Act–designated penthouse in the iconic El Cortez—one of San Diego’s most treasured 1920s Spanish Colonial Revival landmarks. This rare top-floor residence offers dramatic southern, eastern, and western panoramas of downtown and the bay, original architectural details such as decorative plasterwork and period tile, plus sensitive modern upgrades to the kitchen, baths, and building systems. As part of a Mills Act contract, the property conveys both significant historic-preservation protections and attractive property-tax benefits, making ownership a unique blend of cultural stewardship and financial advantage.

Thoughtfully adapted for contemporary living, the penthouse is a 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence featuring a spacious open layout with a primary suite plus a second bedroom, in-unit laundry conveniently located by the kitchen, and access to the building’s secured historic lobby — which includes a secured package room — and elevator. Situated steps from the Gaslamp Quarter, Little Italy, Balboa Park and the Embarcadero, this offering appeals to buyers who value architectural character, downtown convenience, and the prestige of a landmark address—contact the listing agent for full unit specifications, Mills Act terms, parking and HOA details.

results.remarks: RARELY AVAILABLE PARK VIEW 2BR PLUS LOFT overlooking beautiful Pantoja Park!........THIS IS THE LARGEST FLOOR PLAN IN PARK ROW...ONLY 7 OF THESE UNITS ARE DIRECTLY ON THE PARK!  (Not fronting the streets or the trolley!) Flooded with light through upgraded Milgard windows and sliders, 17' ceilings and a large skylight.  Cross ventilation galore brings in the cool breezes off iconic San Diego Bay which is only 2 blocks away!! This fully remodeled gem has new wide-plank engineered hardwood floors, contemporary kitchen with premium stainless appliances and gorgeous custom quartz counters. Spacious primary suite accommodates a king bed and has a large customized closet. Both bathrooms are remodeled with custom tile and quartz counters. In unit washer/dryer. Upstairs loft is open to the living room below...use it as the 3rd BR, home office for a work-from home lifestyle, or as a guest space or a den. Loft has beautiful built-in storage closets with adjustable shelving...suitable for hanging clothes. Park facing balcony is perfect for your morning coffee, al fesco dining & BBQ...also features a storage closet & garden hose spigot for easy cleaning and watering your potted garden!  Resort-like pool, spa and clubhouse! 20 guest parking spaces! Move-in ready! See supplement for more info.  Park Row has 222 units and only 44 are the highly prized 2BR/2BA + loft floor plans. (These are the largest floor-plans in Park Row) Of these 44 units only 7 directly face Pantoja Park....So Unit 4 is a rare offering indeed overlooking San Diego's oldest City park....not fronting the public streets & sidewalks!  Located in the quiet and upscale Marina District where it's a short hop in every direction to the Bay, Convention Center, Little Italy, Seaport Village, trolley & AMTRAK. Only ten minutes to San Diego Airport.  Park Row's 222 units are built on 3 square blocks totaling over 6 acres....this is stunningly low density when compared to nearly all other Downtown developments. The result is not only a generous apportionment of the grounds to gardens but unheard of space for the resort like pool, spa, clubhouse facility and guest parking. Stroll through the walkways of Park Row and enjoy the variety of trees and flowering plants...each courtyard has it's own unique garden & fountain style.   Park Row is adjacent to Pantoja Park on G Street. Residents enjoy direct security gate access to the complex from this beautiful park. Pantoja Park is also the perfect place to take your dog for a walk and meet the neighbors! All units in Park Row come with one assigned parking space in the underground lot. Residents can rent an additional parking space for $60/month from the HOA. Ask agent about parking rules. Generous guest parking in the outside lot adjacent to clubhouse. Each unit has a small storage cabinet in the garage. Bike cage and bike "vaults" are available for rent from the HOA at a nominal cost. 10 SDG&E car chargers can be found in the gated community garages.

Stroll through the walkways of Park Row and enjoy the variety of trees and flowering plants...each courtyard has it's own unique garden & fountain style.   Park Row is adjacent to Pantoja Park on G Street. Residents enjoy direct security gate access to the complex from this beautiful park. Pantoja Park is also the perfect place to take your dog for a walk and meet the neighbors! All units in Park Row come with one assigned parking space in the underground lot. Residents can rent an additional parking space for $60/month from the HOA. Ask agent about parking rules. Generous guest parking in the outside lot adjacent to clubhouse. Each unit has a small storage cabinet in the garage. Bike cage and bike "vaults" are available for rent from the HOA at a nominal cost. 10 SDG&E car chargers can be found in the gated community garages.

results.remarks: Step inside, this home lives differently! One of La Vita’s larger corner floor plans gives you 2 bedrooms plus a flex lounge, eastern morning sun and city views. The bedrooms and bathrooms sit on opposite sides, giving each one a quieter, more private feel. With direct balcony access, the flex lounge works for casual time, gathering with friends, an office, reading spot, TV room, or whatever the day calls for. And it’s completely move in ready.  The kitchen, dining and living areas flow together easily, while each space still feels distinct. Hardwood floors carry through the home, and the living room opens to city views with a fireplace that changes the feel after dark. The kitchen features granite counters, a 5-burner LG gas range and counter-depth LG refrigerator. Both bedrooms have city views and custom organized walk-in closets. There’s also a full size LG front load laundry and 2 side-by-side parking spaces.   La Vita offers a pool, spa, gym, BBQs, rec room, courtyard and a pet friendly setting, with lighter HOA dues that leave more room in the monthly budget. A few minutes’ stroll puts you in the middle of craft coffee, a quick slice, casual lunch or Michelin starred dining. The Farmers Market, Waterfront Park and Embarcadero are all close by, while the Mercato brings evening walks, neighborhood events and live music after dark. It’s the kind of location that makes staying in feel just as good as going out.

results.remarks: If you lived here, you could potentially eliminate your car expenses. Everything you need is within walking distance! Refreshed kitchen with Samsung stainless appliance package including washer/dryer, both bathrooms fully renovated with modern finishes and an extra wide soaking tub. Thoughtfully designed dual-primary layout offers maximum flexibility and privacy, ideal for roommates, guests, or a work-from-home setup. Easy access to the 56, 5, and 805 freeways makes for an effortless commute for when you must leave paradise. This is coastal, low-maintenance living done right!
